title: [DE] Restore rules lost in earlier rewrites

independent_review_comments.body:
Independent review (Claude): 43 figures checked (actual count) against gesetze-im-internet.de (UStG §§ 3c, 12, 13b, 15, 18a, 24; UStDV §§ 17a, 33; EStG §§ 4, 17, 20, 23, 43a, 44, 52; InvStG §§ 16, 18, 20), the 2026 USt 1 A form and the BMF letter of 22 Dec 2025. Lost content restored: 23. All 4 restored worked examples in de-capital-gains recomputed by hand and check-examples passes (0 failures, both files). No protected frontmatter and nothing after the CTA block changed.
Fixed: (1) germany-vat-return said breakfast with a room stays at 19%: wrong for 2026; breakfast food is now 7% under § 12(2) no. 15 (drinks 19%), and the package share is 15% under UStAE 12.16(12) as amended by BMF 22 Dec 2025. (2) The entry-certificate rule cited § 17a UStDV but misstated it; rewritten to the actual presumption (two independent documents; plus the Gelangensbestätigung by the 10th of the next month where the customer transports). (3) § 24 row omitted the 19% average rate for sawmill products and drinks. (4) Vorabpauschale step 6 had no citation; added § 16(1) no. 2 and § 20(1) InvStG and § 44(1), (1b) EStG. (5) The 'while facts are missing' defaults are labelled as working practice, not law.
Still not confirmed: EUR 50 gift limit counted by calendar year for VAT; machine-produced signed entertainment receipt (both already on Not yet confirmed).
